shellCommands.command: cat package.json && echo "---TREE---" && git ls-files | head -100

ls node_modules 2>/dev/null | head -5 || echo "NO node_modules"; echo "---"; cat node_modules/react/package.json 2>/dev/null | grep version; cat node_modules/next/package.json 2>/dev/null | grep '"version"'

node -e "const r=require('react'); console.log('ViewTransition:', typeof r.unstable_ViewTransition); console.log('addTransitionType:', typeof r.unstable_addTransitionType); console.log('startTransition:', typeof r.startTransition);" 2>&1 | head

grep -rn "transitionTypes" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/shared/lib/app-router-context.shared-runtime.d.ts; echo "---ROUTER---"; grep -n "transitionTypes" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/use-router.md; echo "---REACT VT export---"; grep -rn "ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.react-server.development.js 2>/dev/null | head -3; node -e "process.env.NODE_ENV='development'; const r=require('/workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/index.js'); console.log('next-react ViewTransition:', typeof r.ViewTransition, 'addTransitionType:', typeof r.unstable_addTransitionType)"
grep -rn "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head -5; echo "---build---"; timeout 300 npm run build 2>&1 | tail -40
